_what: Input specification for scripts/core_polarity.py (PREREGISTRATION 10a, 10b, 10c). Committed so that the Phi numbers are reproducible from this repository. Rise and twist are the DEPOSITED helical parameters; entries without them are analysed as deposited and flagged in the output.
_layers: The registered replication is 11 layers and that is the script default. The 18 Nov 2026 run executed 13; both are reported so the deviation is a measured number rather than an argument.
_ranges: A range may be discontinuous (PREREGISTRATION 10c), written as comma-separated segments. Gaps are never interpolated.
_frozen_rows: The seven 'row' entries are the incumbent Phi set and are NOT re-selected (PREREGISTRATION 10b S3). Note FUS is analysed over 39-95, which is the registered range and is narrower than the 37-97 modelled span recorded in data/regions.json; it is left as registered.

rows.label: Orb2 176-206
rows.range_note: DEPOSIT FRAME, NOT THE UNIPROT FRAME. 6VPS numbers its modelled residues 23-53; the UniProt span is recorded only in _entity.pdbx_fragment as 'UNP residues 176-206'. The offset is -153. The 31 modelled residues read QLHQQQHQQQHQQHQQHQQQQQLHQHQQQLS in all nine chains, which matches Orb2B 176-206 character for character, so the two frames describe the same region. Using 176-206 here selects NO ATOMS and the script errors rather than scoring something else -- which is how this was found, on 19 Nov 2026.

_deposit_frames: A deposit's auth_seq_id numbering is NOT always the UniProt frame. 6VPS is offset by -153. Every 'range' in this file is in the DEPOSIT's own numbering, because that is what the coordinates carry; where it differs from the frame recorded in data/regions.json, 'uniprot_range' and 'range_note' say so.
